findings.evidence: PDF p.7-8: Contents lists 26 chapters, Appendix A, Glossary, References, Sources/Method, and Architecture Worksheet. No List of Tables appears anywhere in the front matter (pp.7-11). The body references numerous tables: Table 4-1, 4-2, 5-1, 5-2, 6-1, 7-1, 7-2, 7-3, 8-1, 2-1, 3-1, 3-2, 3-3, 17-1, 22-1.
findings.issue: No List of Tables in a 519-page technical handbook that references at least 15+ tables across chapters. The front matter includes a List of Figures (pp.9-11) and a full Contents (pp.7-8), but tables are a primary data structure throughout the book (e.g., Table 4-2 'Canonical-scenario provenance ledger' is called 'the one authoritative set of numbers every chapter disciplines on'). Without a List of Tables, readers cannot quickly locate Table 4-2, Table 17-1, or other key reference tables.
findings.fix_instruction: Add a List of Tables page after the List of Figures (after p.11), listing every table by number, title, and printed page, consistent with the existing List of Figures format.

findings.evidence: Contents ... 16 TCO: The Total Cost Reality Check . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 277 ... A Appendix A — 2026 Frontier Architecture Signals: Four Open-Weight Model Families . . . . 459
findings.issue: The Contents lists 26 numbered chapters plus Appendix A, Glossary, References, Sources/Method, and The Architecture Worksheet, and gives page numbers. The pagination of the body is offset from the printed page numbers by the front matter (the Contents itself is labelled 'i' on p. 7, and Ch. 1 begins at printed page 1 on PDF p. 22). Several Contents entries for the tail material (Glossary 492, References 497, Sources 500, Worksheet 508) imply the appendix apparatus extends past p. 508 of printed numbering, while the rendered document's page count differs. The Contents gives no 'last page' or total-page marker, and no note that page numbers are printed folio numbers distinct from PDF pagination — a reader using a PDF viewer will systematically mis-navigate.
findings.fix_instruction: Add a note under the Contents heading: 'Page numbers in this Contents are printed folio numbers; PDF page indices are offset by the front matter (Ch. 1 = printed p. 1 = PDF p. 22).' Optionally add a 'printed page ↔ PDF page' alignment note on the copyright page.

findings.evidence: List of Figures ... 7.1 Grouped-Query Attention cuts per-token KV . . . 125 ... 7.8 Memory Tetris . . . 145
findings.issue: The List of Figures is given in two parts (pp. 9–11) and the second part's entries (A.1–A.5) are placed on a separate 'v' folio, but the List of Tables is absent entirely, although the body contains at least 30 numbered tables (Table 1-1, 2-1, 3-1 through 3-3, 4-1, 4-2, 5-1, 5-2, 6-1, 7-1 through 7-3, 8-1, and many more in Chs. 11–26). A reader auditing the evidence ledger (the book's own load-bearing discipline) cannot enumerate the tables that carry provenance labels, and the absence breaks the symmetry the List of Figures establishes.
findings.fix_instruction: Add a 'List of Tables' after the List of Figures, listing every numbered table with its chapter, caption, and printed page, mirroring the List of Figures format.
